name: Mion
source:
The rumored delinquent who spends most of her time away from classes. Mion is a quiet girl who observes the world around her. She is feared though by others due to her height and rumors of her being in a gang. Mion though is the type not to get into meaningless things and prefers to do things at her own pace. Though mature and sensible, she can have quite a temper when pushed, and often finds things like friends and romance meaningless.
